modernize-compat-analyst.question: Keep the explicit jakarta.servlet-api dependency that the preview adds to web/pom.xml?
modernize-compat-analyst.why: spring-boot-starter-web already provides the servlet API on the compile classpath.

modernize-compat-analyst.question: Should the web module get a smoke check before approval?
modernize-compat-analyst.recommendation: Yes. Load the list page and one view-page once after the upgrade.
modernize-compat-analyst.why: The web module has no tests, so the baseline does not cover it.

modernize-compat-analyst.question: Keep spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update on an existing PostgreSQL schema?
modernize-compat-analyst.recommendation: Keep it, but run the upgraded app once against a copy of the database first.
modernize-compat-analyst.why: Hibernate 6 can change how it updates an existing schema.

modernize-dependency-analyst.question: Should we upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 3.5.16?
modernize-dependency-analyst.recommendation: Yes. This is the latest Spring Boot 3.5.x version and is required for Java 21 compatibility and to fix 17 CRITICAL vulnerabilities (Tomcat, Spring WebMVC, Netty, Thymeleaf).
modernize-dependency-analyst.why: The BOM upgrade addresses ~90% of the 169 known vulnerabilities and enables Java 21 support across all dependencies.

modernize-dependency-analyst.question: Should we upgrade PostgreSQL driver from 42.3.8 to 42.7.14?
modernize-dependency-analyst.recommendation: Yes. This version is required to fix 2 CRITICAL CVEs (CVE-2023-22045, CVE-2024-1597) in the current driver.
modernize-dependency-analyst.why: 42.3.8 has known security vulnerabilities; 42.7.14 is the latest stable version compatible with Java 21.

modernize-dependency-analyst.question: Should we upgrade Lombok from 1.18.30 to 1.18.48?
modernize-dependency-analyst.recommendation: Yes. This version has improved Java 21 annotation processor support and fixes for JDK 21 internal API removals.
modernize-dependency-analyst.why: Lombok 1.18.30 uses javac internal APIs that are inaccessible in Java 21; 1.18.48 removes this dependency.
